## Identity & Positioning

The Computer Science Club at Pitt (Pitt CSC) is the largest student organization at the University of Pittsburgh and a partner of the School of Computing and Information.

- Official name: Computer Science Club at Pitt
- Alternate names: CSC at Pitt, Pitt CSC, Pitt Computer Science Club
- Location: Pittsburgh, PA (University of Pittsburgh)
- Partner school: School of Computing and Information, University of Pittsburgh
- Mission: To help create an engaging atmosphere for students to learn more about the field of computer science and develop professionally.
- Membership: Open to all majors. Meetings are typically held Mondays and Thursdays at 8pm.
- Contact email: pittcsc@gmail.com

## Club Scale & Reach

- Active members: 750+
- Social reach: 15K followers across social platforms, 100M+ total reel views, 750K average views per video.
- Events per year: 75+ events/year on /sponsors/ and in the 2026-2027 sponsorship package; 70+ events on /about/ (e-board confirmation is pending to align the events/year count).

## Initiatives & Programs

- **Zero to Offer** (Career): Student-run fall workshop series covering resumes, recruiting, and interviews for your first tech internship. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/z2o/)
- **Foundry** (Career): A smaller community for consistent builders: interview practice, project work, presentations, and peer accountability. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/foundry/)
- **Mock Interviews** (Career): Practice technical, behavioral, and company-specific interviews with experienced peers and get honest feedback. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/mock-interviews/)
- **Industry Recruiting Events** (Career): Meet engineers and recruiters on campus through company tech talks, info sessions, and coding competitions. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/industry-recruiting/)
- **Site Visits** (Career): Tour Pittsburgh tech offices like Google, Duolingo, and Aurora and talk directly with local engineers. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/site-visits/)
- **Launchpad** (Career): Hands-on software engineering workshops covering dev setup, data, UIs, and deployment to get you ready to build. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/launchpad/)
- **Dev Lab** (Project Teams): Pitch or join a semester-long project team and practice Git, PR reviews, testing, and deployments. (https://pittcs.wiki/guides/skills/csc-dev-lab)
- **Consulting** (Project Teams): Apply to work on a small semester-long engineering team building and delivering real software for a partner company. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/consulting/)
- **CSC Hacks** (Hackathons): Pitt CSC's 48-hour internal hackathon for teams of up to three, wrapping up with 5-minute live demos and prizes. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/csc-hacks/)
- **SteelHacks** (Hackathons): Pitt's free annual hackathon hosted by CSC and SCI. Spend a weekend on campus building, learning, and demoing. (https://steelhacks.org)
- **Bit/Byte** (Mentorship): Get paired with a Pitt CS upperclassman for class advice, resume help, and a friendly face in the club. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/bit-byte/)
- **Fireside Chats** (Guest Speakers): Live on-campus Q&A nights where Pitt alumni, startup founders, and tech creators talk candidly with students. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/fireside-chats/)
- **Social Events** (Social): Jeopardy nights, game nights, outings, and the Tech Club Formal so you can actually meet people outside class. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/social-events/)
- **Social Media** (Social): Follow @csc.at.pitt for event updates, intern takeovers, member spotlights, and CS reels, or help us make them. (https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/social-media/)

## Sponsorship & Partnerships

- Current sponsors on /sponsors/: BNY (https://www.bny.com/), CGI (https://www.cgi.com/), Roblox (https://www.roblox.com/), Naval Nuclear Lab (https://navalnuclearlab.energy.gov/), Stevens Capital Management (https://www.scm-lp.com/), Aerotech (https://www.aerotech.com/), FAST Enterprises (https://www.fastenterprises.com/), Wesco (https://www.wesco.com/)
- Sponsorship validity: September 1 to August 31
- 2026-2027 Partnership Package PDF: https://pittcsc.org/Pitt_CSC_Sponsorship_Package_2026-2027.pdf

### Tiers

- Tier 1 — Ada Lovelace ($1,000/year): Logo on the CSC website and Wiki; Recruiting & campus outreach featured in weekly newsletters; Ability to promote campus visits.
- Tier 2 — Alan Turing ($1,500/year): Includes Tier 1, plus Logo on CSC at Pitt t-shirts; Invitation to host one (1) custom company event.
- Tier 3 — John von Neumann ($2,500/year): Includes Tier 2, plus Host up to two (2) custom company events; Exclusive access to the club's member resume book.
- Tier 4 — Grace Hopper ($5,000/year): Includes Tier 3, plus Host up to three (3) custom company events; Exclusively sponsor a CSC initiative (Zero to Offer, Foundry, mentorship, etc.); Present at an event during Zero to Offer or Foundry.

### Social Media Add-Ons

- 1-Day Story Takeover ($100): Post stories on the CSC Instagram for a day; Highlight posted stories for a semester (+$200).
- Single Reel Video ($500): Feature in a custom Instagram reel; Reach thousands of engaged followers.
